description:
One-call background-delegation dispatch over a raw user message. Runs FOUR deterministic classifiers in one pass: (1) delegation — decideBackgroundDelegation's { shouldDelegate, reason, matchedKeywords, estimatedSteps 1..10, complexityScore 0..10 } deciding whether the request should run as a tracked background task instead of inline; (2) statusQuery — boolean for short 'what are you working on' background-task status turns; (3) logQuery — { shouldShowLog, workerId? } for explicit log/output requests; (4) cancelQuery — { shouldCancel, workerId? } for cancel requests with a negation guard ('don't cancel' never cancels). Optional workerIdPattern (RegExp source, compiled case-insensitively) overrides the default `*task-<8 hex>` worker-id shape for log/cancel id extraction; invalid patterns fail schema validation (400). No LLM calls, no fs, no network, no session state — pure string analysis.

Free: does not call an AI provider.
name: resolveBackgroundDelegation
